steps.what: Send the questionnaire or information request
Match questions to the standard list
Draft answers from signed product facts

loop.input: standard question ids and signed fact text
loop.output: answers that cite a signed fact id
loop.check: Each answer cites a signed fact id for that product and question id
loop.stop: One draft; leave a question blank if it is not on the standard list or has no fact
loop.why_not_simpler: The customer's wording still varies, so a fixed mail-merge cannot write the odd items

steps.what: Write an answer the list does not cover
Sign the external answer version
Send only the signed answer

tasks.design: The customer contact sends a question id or free text, plus product id and account id, by {EMAIL}. Standard question ids match signed facts in {DOCS}. A bounded draft answers only those. The specialist signs the external version, and only that version is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Questionnaires arrived as different files, and the product facts they needed were not marked as signed, so a draft could mix a guess with a fact.
tasks.enabler_now: A standard question can carry an id, and a signed fact can carry the same id plus a product id.
tasks.still_hard: Odd questions, and any answer that would leave the firm, still need the specialist's signature. A wrong external statement is hard to take back.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist signs what the customer may be told and writes any answer the standard list does not cover.

ambition.what: A customer contact with only a standard questionnaire gets a signed answer without booking a meeting

tasks.altitude: Repeat questions take a draft and a signature. The specialist can refuse to send an answer that cites no signed fact, and free-text questions stay on their desk.

reach.task: Send the signed answer back to the customer
reach.learn: Which questions were answered from signed facts and which are still open

evidence.claim: The digest's deterministic-first section groups letters as a bounded loop over approved sources, with a named person signing.
Digest [S27] says a consultancy partly repaid a public report that cited sources that did not exist, so a regulatory statement must not cite a fact that is not signed.
A mid-size firm's repeat questionnaires share a core of questions, and the rest are one-off wording. Only the core can be matched by id.

assumptions: Focal role is the regulatory affairs specialist. The task ends when the signed answer is sent or the odd question is handed back. It does not include a meeting with the customer.

Input contract: account id, product id, question id or free text, signed fact id, fact text, fact version. Producer of the request is the customer contact. A question with no question id skips the draft and goes to the manual answer. A standard question with no signed fact stays blank.

Configure the mailbox template and the fact list before custom code. The prior meeting share is the occasional call; this design does not replace a call the customer still needs. Sending is allowed only for the signed version.
unknowns: Whether the customer contact may see draft answers or only the signed version.
Which products have a signed fact list.
Who may sign an external answer when the specialist is absent.
research_questions: What share of incoming questions match a standard question id?
How often is a signed answer corrected after it was sent?

already_counted.description: Specialist corrects a draft answer before signing
Odd questions stay with the specialist

incremental.description: Add a standard question id when the same odd question repeats
Customer contacts resend a file that had no product id

approvals.approved_version: external answer version signed for this request id
the same signed external answer version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most requests are free text with no question id, so the draft does not run and the specialist still writes the answer. The high case assumes standard ids match but every external send is still signed and every odd question is still written by hand. Customer calls are not treated as saved.

tasks.short: Recommend how a product complaint is closed

steps.what: Log the complaint with product and lot
Open complaints for the same product and lot
Recommend and sign the adjudication
File only the signed recommendation
Check the signed recommendation is complete
Sign the recommendation with no history

tasks.design: The quality reviewer logs complaint id, product id, lot, date and description in the {HELPDESK}. The specialist reads other complaints with the same product and lot, recommends the adjudication, and signs it in {DOCS}. Only that signed recommendation is written back. No score closes the complaint.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint history was free text, so similar lots were hard to line up, and a recommendation had no version anyone could point to.
tasks.enabler_now: The complaint record can filter on product id and lot, which is a field match rather than a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: What should happen to the complaint is a decision. A similar lot is context, not an outcome.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist recommends the adjudication and signs it. A list of old complaints does not decide this one.
tasks.altitude: Finding the same lot takes less time. The specialist still makes the recommendation, and an unsigned recommendation is not written onto the complaint.

reach.task: Record the signed recommendation on the complaint
reach.learn: Which complaint has a signed recommendation and which is still waiting

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a contract, a law or explicit consent, and a person who can intervene.
Digest [S21] says a score that determines an outcome counts as an automated decision. This recommendation is not left to a score.
Product-complaint adjudication in a mid-size firm is a case decision on a file. A filter can gather the same lot. It cannot choose the outcome.

assumptions: Focal role is the regulatory affairs specialist. The task ends at the signed recommendation on the complaint. Telling the customer, and any field action, are out of scope.

Input contract: complaint id, product id, lot, date, description, prior complaint id. Producer is the quality reviewer. A complaint with no product id and no lot stays on the manual queue and is not matched.

Configure the complaint queue's own filter and fields before custom code. The model prior is not a reason to draft the outcome. The same-lot list is a filter. The recommendation is written by the specialist.
unknowns: Who else must agree before a recommendation is treated as the closure.
Whether complaint text contains personal data that must stay out of wider views.
Who may sign when the specialist is absent.
research_questions: What share of complaints have a product id and a lot?
How often is a signed recommendation later changed?

already_counted.description: The adjudication itself stays with the specialist
Complaints with no history stay with the specialist

incremental.description: Keep the complaint fields aligned when a new product family is added
Quality reviewers complete records that arrived without a lot

approvals.approved_version: adjudication recommendation signed for this complaint id
manual recommendation signed for this complaint id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes lots are missing, so the filter helps little and the specialist still searches the file. The high case assumes the same-lot list is clean but every recommendation is still signed by the specialist. No complaint is closed by a score, and customer contact time is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Judge implications of an ozone-depleting substance

steps.what: Submit the substance, use and market
Confirm which rule applies to this case
Draft the note from the attached rule text

loop.input: rule text the specialist marked as confirmed
loop.output: note that quotes only that text
loop.check: Every quote appears in the confirmed text and no instrument number is added
loop.stop: If no rule text is confirmed, return an empty note and stop
loop.why_not_simpler: A table of substance names would invent a rule the specialist has not confirmed

steps.what: Sign this legal implication version
File only the signed implication note
Update the equipment list from the note

tasks.design: The project lead submits substance or equipment id, use, market and any rule text they hold, on a {WORKFLOW} form. The specialist confirms which rule applies. A bounded note in {DOCS} may quote only that attached text, and only the signed note is filed. No instrument number is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Substance questions arrived as names in mail, with no use and no attached text, so a note could not show what the specialist had actually confirmed.
tasks.enabler_now: The request can store substance or equipment id, use, market and an attached rule text as separate fields.
tasks.still_hard: Confirming which rule applies, and what it means for this use, is the specialist's call. A name match is not a legal conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist confirms the applicable rule and signs the implication. The note may not invent an instrument.

ambition.what: Confirm a substance or equipment item before it is purchased, not after it is already on site

tasks.altitude: Blank requests go back. The specialist still makes the legal call, and equipment status changes only from the signed note.

reach.task: Hold a purchase until the signed implication exists
reach.learn: Which substance has a confirmed rule and which request is still blank

evidence.claim: The applicable rule is confirmed by the specialist for the substance or equipment, the use and the market. This task names no instrument.
Digest [S27] says a consultancy partly repaid a public report that cited sources that did not exist, so the note must not add a citation that was not attached.
Firms rarely have one system that already knows the legal implication of a substance. The prior agrees: standard software is usually absent, and the call stays with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the regulatory affairs specialist. The task ends at the signed implication note. Buying, installing or disposing of the equipment is out of scope.

Input contract: substance or equipment id, use (production, supply or use), market, attached rule text, attachment document id. Producer is the project lead. If no rule text is attached, the draft is empty and the specialist either attaches a text they accept or stops. The draft must not insert an instrument number.
Configure the request form in the existing workflow tool before custom code. Do not maintain a private table that maps a substance name to a legal outcome.
unknowns: Which uses and markets this firm actually has.
Whether the project lead can attach the rule text or only a title.
Who may sign when the specialist is absent.
research_questions: What share of requests arrive with a rule text attached?
How often does the specialist reject the text the project lead attached?

already_counted.description: Confirming the applicable rule stays with the specialist
Specialist edits a note that quoted the wrong passage

incremental.description: Keep the request fields aligned when a new use type appears
Project leads attach a missing rule text and resubmit

approvals.approved_version: implication note version signed for this substance or equipment id
the same signed implication note version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes requests arrive as names only, so there is nothing to quote and the specialist still researches by hand. The high case assumes a text is attached but the confirmation and the signature stay manual. No legal outcome is filled by a name match, and purchasing time is not treated as saved.

tasks.short: Confirm handling rules for a hazardous waste stream

steps.what: Describe the waste stream and destination
Confirm the rule for each handling leg
Draft the note from confirmed legs only

loop.input: legs the specialist marked confirmed, and their text
loop.output: note with those legs filled and the others blank
loop.check: A filled leg copies only the confirmed text for that stream id
loop.stop: One draft; do not fill a blank leg, then stop
loop.why_not_simpler: The four legs do not share one sentence, and a template would hide a leg left open

steps.what: Sign the handling note for this stream
Publish only the signed handling note
Check the store against the signed note

tasks.design: The project lead submits stream id, process step, physical form and destination type on a {WORKFLOW} form. The specialist confirms the requirement for treatment, storage, shipment or disposal. A bounded note in {DOCS} leaves a leg blank when it was not confirmed, and only the signed note is published for the people who handle that stream.
tasks.previous_blocker: Waste questions mixed the four handling legs in one mail, so a later reader could not see which leg had actually been confirmed.
tasks.enabler_now: The request can store each leg separately, and the note can stay blank on a leg the specialist did not mark.
tasks.still_hard: The applicable requirement is confirmed by the specialist. A blank leg is not a permission to ship or to store.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist confirms each leg they are willing to stand behind and signs the note. They leave the others blank.

ambition.what: Confirm handling before a new process step starts, not after the waste is already stored

tasks.altitude: The specialist no longer retypes a complete-looking note over an open question. Staff may follow only the signed legs, and a store check still happens in person.

reach.task: Check the store against the signed handling note
reach.learn: Which legs are confirmed and which are still blank

evidence.claim: The applicable requirement is confirmed by the specialist for the stream and the leg. This task names no instrument and sets no limit.
Digest [S27] says a consultancy partly repaid a public report that cited sources that did not exist, so a handling note must not fill a leg the specialist left blank.
Hazardous-waste questions in a mid-size firm are case reads of documents, not a standard screen. The store check stays a visit.

assumptions: Focal role is the regulatory affairs specialist. The task ends at the signed handling note and the store check against it. It does not book a carrier or sign a transfer document.

Input contract: stream id, process step, physical form, destination type, leg (treatment, storage, shipment or disposal), confirmed text for that leg. Producer is the project lead. A leg with no confirmed text stays blank. The draft must not copy another stream's text into a blank leg.

Configure the request form and the document template before custom code. Do not keep a table that turns a waste name into a handling method. The operations record may show the stream id, but it does not decide the requirement.
unknowns: Which process steps produce a stream that has no id yet.
Whether storage locations are already on a list the quality reviewer can walk.
Who may sign when the specialist is absent.
research_questions: What share of streams have at least one leg left blank?
How often does the store check find a leg the note did not confirm?

already_counted.description: Confirming each handling leg stays with the specialist
Specialist clears a leg the draft filled by mistake

incremental.description: Adjust the leg form when a new destination type appears
Quality reviewers record a store check that found a blank leg

approvals.approved_version: handling note version signed for this stream id
the same signed handling note version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes stream descriptions stay free text, so legs cannot be separated and the specialist still writes the note by hand. The high case assumes the form is used but every confirmation, every signature and the store visit stay manual. Carrier booking is not treated as saved.

role.altitude: The specialist spends less of the week on standard questionnaires and blank registers, and keeps the complaint recommendation, the legal call and the external signature.
reach: Customer contacts receive only the signed answer, with odd questions still open.
Quality reviewers receive the signed complaint recommendation and the signed handling note.
skills_to_grow: Answer a standard question only from a signed fact, and leave the rest blank.
Recommend how a complaint closes without letting a score decide.
Record a substance or a waste stream so the applicable rule is a field the specialist fills.
role.ambitious_version: Standard customer questions and known waste streams have a signed note before anyone acts, and anything odd waits for the specialist.
